page.overview:
Who is Celessa?

Previously, has met , calling her a wonderful woman and suggesting meet her as well. She praises her lovely personality, having learned history from her.

At , will explain to that it was built to stop the . She describes an ancient battle once took place there, referring to the events of the . She laments the tragic battle where many soldiers lost their lives protecting from the onslaught of , wishing to honor their sacrifice. She hopes that the souls of those who lost their lives have found peace.

During her stop at , pays a visit to the . She remarks that, while escaped the brunt of the , its peace feels precarious. As a fellow traveler, she asks if he can feel it as well.

When is caught in the , she wonders if it is also at . She also wishes for the spirit of to be at peace.
